smell_validity.evidence: Seven model files absorb layout/staging and raw-parameter-initialization helpers into single constructor or factory bodies, exactly fusing the distinct responsibilities the smell names. Deliberately drifted sibling copies that must still build identical networks, and a dense case mixing growth arithmetic with init, make the cost of the folded form unmistakable even without the label.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Tuning gains, bias handling, or cfg widths must now happen inside fused constructor blocks, and the same conventions must be kept consistent across hand-drifted sibling copies. The inlined form repeatedly forces unrelated layout and initialization details to be considered together, so repair restores durable per-family ownership, not just tidiness.

development_plausibility.evidence: The folded bodies use authentic PyTorch idioms, per-file comment voice, and per-site assembly drift; several pipelines keep original helpers, leaving realistically partial decay. Absorbed code preserves construction behavior exactly, so the bad design reads as an ordinary researcher compromise (tune with the whole network visible), showing no task-shaped scaffolding.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt pins problem, scope, finished state, and the fragile invariants: attribute registration order, RNG consumption order, width conventions, init gating, pretrained path, signatures; it excludes drivers, test edits, new deps, and pushes investigation across families to block partial cleanup. This converts an ambiguous refactor into a contract that prevents silent divergence and irrelevant redesign.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Four purpose groups need different code-supported decisions: flattening cfg-driven feature stacks; extracting residual stages while preserving inplanes threading and two distinct shortcut protocols; splitting nested dense/transition loops with growth arithmetic and compression arithmetic; relocating factory orchestration with keyword-gated init and checkpoint ordering. No single decision rule spans the sites.

localization_burden.evidence: Scope spans many per-method pipeline trees holding duplicated architectures; the solver must survey model files broadly, recognize dynamic 'layer%d' registration that hides navigated names, and exclude plausible untouched twins still delegating to helpers in sibling pipelines. Deciding repairability combines file content with pipeline context the prompt only sketches.

repair_coordination.evidence: Shared rules bind sites: sibling VGG pipelines must construct identical networks; densenet extraction must keep channel threading and transition cfg indices consistent across seams; slimming factory init gating interlocks with class initialization and checkpoint ordering. A partial repair works locally but fails across stages: mishandled gating double-initializes while existing pins still pass.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: The best uniform rule, hoisting the cfg-expansion loop into a make_layers-style helper, covers only the near-identical VGG pair, roughly two of seven sites. Residual, dense, and factory sites need different seams, state threading, shortcut protocols, and ordering decisions; wholesale cut-paste preserves behavior but leaves staging and init fused, repairing nothing.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Wrong edits compile and forward correctly: state-dict asserts use unordered key sets and nothing pins exact weight values or draw counts, so double initialization from faulty factory gating, reordered RNG consumption, or lost init distinctions pass the suite while changing seeded runs. The harness's own assertions show these hidden interacting failure paths unchecked.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
